$comment: The 1378 start scenario (X-25, milestone 10 step 5), being built. Not bundled yet: the game still starts from scenarios/1444 until the switch-over (step 7). Its data is written region by region under regions/<region>/, so the threads building each region never edit the same file; packages/rules/src/scenarios.ts joins the regions in the order below. Each region folder holds files with the same names and shapes as scenarios/1444, carrying only that region's entries.
name: Autumn 1378

eras.$comment: Era I is stretched back to the start (plan-1378.md 3.2, decided 19 Oct 2026).

files.regions/<region>/map-nations.json: the region's map nations with their capitals (SETUP-040)
files.regions/<region>/map-owners.json: owner rules handing the region's provinces to its nations, first match wins (SETUP-041); the regions' rules are joined in the order of regions
files.regions/<region>/sleeping-realms.json: realms born after the start, asleep until they wake (SETUP-080, X-25): { realms: [...] }
files.regions/<region>/rulers.json: each map realm's ruler on the start day (REALM-233): { rulers: { id: ruler } }
files.regions/<region>/culture-start.json: court tongues, province tongues and faiths on the start day (CULT-094): { tongues, realms }
files.regions/<region>/relations.json: relations between realms on the start day (DIPL-020): { relations: [...] }, a relation sits in the region of its source
files.regions/<region>/subjects.json: subject records on the start day (SUBJ): { subjects: [...] }
files.regions/<region>/subjects-rulers.json: rulers the subjects context names: { rulers: { id: ruler } }
files.regions/<region>/ports.json: towns placed as ports on the start day (NAVY-013): { towns: [...] }
